Randy's Wish List Supercars — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Vice City and across Leonida (Randy is based in Balsero)

A collector with a list of twenty-two dream cars pays life-changing money for each one — delivered spotless.

Full guide — contains spoilers

Midway through Chapter 3, the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives you the Key Cloner and unlocks Randy's Wish List of 22 high-end sports cars — 20 on the initial board, plus the '64 Mamba GT added by the ¡Dale Mamba! job and the Truffade Thrax as the finale. Each delivery is usually worth $30,000 or more per car (PowerPyx's 100% guide says ~$35,000+ for Randy's sports cars), but only in perfect condition — one crash on the way slashes the payout. The cars drive around Vice City, and you can text Randy from the phone's Reminders section for tips on where they are parked.

Source & evidence

Source: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter — GameMapa (built on PowerPyx's money guide) (2026-11-18).

Evidence: Chapter-by-chapter money guide read in full; figures attributed to PowerPyx.. Wish-list size reconciled at 22 (RadioTimes, Push Square): 20 cars on the initial board plus the Mamba GT and Thrax. PowerPyx tracks 16 core targets for the Supply & Demand trophy and KeenGamer counts 18 — both are subsets. The $30,000+ figure is per car; no outlet has published a verified total for the full list.
